create_pipeline_pag_controlnet_sd_xl: create a StableDiffusionXLControlNetPAGPipeline instance with vae, text encoders, tokenizer, unet, controlnet, and scheduler
run_pipeline_text_to_image: run the pipeline to generate images from text prompts with controlnet conditioning and perturbed attention guidance
